name: Disguise Kit
description:
Cosmetics, dyes and small costume props support changes to appearance. Tool proficiency applies to appropriate disguise checks.

Uses the 2014 rules; the GM resolves applicability. Legality depends on the campaign.

name: Reversible Hooded Cloak
description:
A plain cloak reverses between two subdued colours and has a deep hood. It changes clothing appearance without concealing identity automatically.

Legality and provenance depend on the campaign. The GM confirms restrictions and any checks; this item grants no automatic access, immunity or bonus.
